scope: Supplemental fifth case, selected after reading the original four. H01 did not supply the planned important quiet contrast. Original four remain in results without replacement. Rules stay timingv14; no product or engine output read for this board before declaration.

cases.source: 100 Endgame Patterns, personal reading PDF page60, Zamarbide-Benitez La Roda2005, White35g4? versus35Ke3!, diagram visually checked.
cases.history_limit: The diagram fixes the board and side. Earlier history and halfmove clock are unavailable; use zero for this research start, no repetition or fifty-move inference.
cases.human_task: Test whether immediately spending g3-g4 allows ...f6 and a king blockade, while Ke3 preserves g4 as a later waiting move to gain f5. The move order must matter against the opponent best replies, not only the book line.
falsifiers: If g4 still wins, reject the lost-win hypothesis.
If Ke3 does not win in bounded searches, do not assume the book judgment is proven.
Do not call one PV forced or equate a pawn-count difference with the waiting-move mechanism.
